producer_report.summary: I wrote docs/design/warm-baseline-build.md, a design note for keeping a warm baseline build of main. The baseline is keyed by a hash of rust-toolchain.toml and Cargo.lock, rebuilt in the background, and copied into each check run's own target directory instead of starting empty. The note cites review 20261029-155931-wfkr and the measured 25.4 / 14.1 / 6.8 minute figures. It states the 8.0-minute predicted saving and how the next review measures it: the median over the last 20 landed jobs, with checks compared against 14.1 and 25.4, plus a per-run hit-or-miss record. It reviews four alternatives (no change, shared target directory, sccache, per-commit baselines) and six risks. I also added a CHANGELOG.md entry. Nothing is implemented. The policy test passes.
